description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with JWT token issuance and tenant-based user management.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Performs a health check on tenant salt configuration, returning status flags and warnings.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Creates or updates a user with hashed password, auto-generates tenant salt if missing, and sets hash version to 2.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and organization, issues JWT token, and performs on-login migration from legacy hashes.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Resets a user's password using the v2 hashing scheme, generating tenant salt if needed.
